4940.title: Enable lifecycle failures remain success-shaped
4940.rootCauseOneLine: The enable route marks every known plugin successful even after a failed load; the CLI trusts that envelope and exits zero.
4940.proposedFix: Return a failed enable outcome for status error at the server boundary, preserving safe-mode-held success. No autopilot PR because this changes public API success/error semantics.
4940.caveats: Same agent repeated in a clean checkout. Initial broken-install and provider-conflict variants, and the published npm distribution, were not separately exercised.
